text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ تَبَّتْ يَدَآ أَبِى لَهَبٍۢ وَتَبَّ

translations.asad: DOOMED are the hands of him of the glowing countence: and doomed is he!
translations.sahih: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.

text.arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ

translations.asad: What will his wealth avail him, and all that he has gained?
translations.sahih: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.

translations.asad: [In the life to come] he shall have to endure a fire fiercely glowing;
translations.sahih: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame

translations.asad: together with his wife, that carrier of evil tales,
translations.sahih: And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.

translations.asad: [who bears] around her neck a rope of twisted strands!
translations.sahih: Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.
